## 🔍 Truth check

- **Claim:** Social media posts claim DOGE laid off 400 FAA technicians responsible for critical airport navigation systems.
- **Verdict:** ⚪ Unverified / Misleading. Federal aviation officials confirmed routine staffing adjustments occurred, but reports claiming mass firings of navigation technicians lack official documentation. ## 🎓 Today's lesson

- **Concept: FII vs. DII (Foreign vs. Domestic Institutional Investors)**
  - **What it means:** Institutional investors are large entities—like mutual funds, banks, and pension funds—that move massive amounts of money in financial markets.
  - **The difference:** **FIIs** (Foreign Portfolio Investors) invest capital from outside the country, while **DIIs** (Domestic Institutional Investors, like Indian mutual funds or LIC) invest local savings.
  - **Why it matters today:** When global markets drop, FIIs often shift funds across borders. Today, FIIs poured over $12 billion into Indian stocks, shielding India's stock market from the global tech sell-off. [[Economic Times]](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/forex/rupee-strengthens-17-paise-to-93-15-against-us-dollar-in-early-trade/articleshow/136013858.cms) [[The Hindu]](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/indias-ai-free-appeal-draws-record-foreign-buying-earnings-will-decide-if-it-lasts/article71723853.ece)
